verdict.rationale: YYLO keeps user data in the user's own Git checkout as open, inspectable files: Ledger records are Git-native, the Wiki is Markdown, and workflows are saved as YAML. That makes the data inherently portable, but the evidence never documents an export command or a stated exit path. Missing for 10: an explicit export or portability feature, documentation that every data type (e.g. Records and artifact payloads) uses an open format, and independent corroboration of leaving cleanly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: code, notebooks, notes and Ledger in one Git checkout.
